title: papaver somniferum f. album
intro: Papaver somniferum f. album, commonly known as white poppy, is a variety of the opium poppy plant that is cultivated for its medicinal and ornamental purposes. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, and promoting relaxation and sleep. The therapeutic actions of Papaver somniferum f. album are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as thebaine, codeine, and morphine, as well as other compounds like papaverine and noscapine. However, the plant's use must be approached with caution due to the potential for opium poppy extracts to be habit-forming and addictive, and further research is needed to fully understand its effects and benefits.
